name: Eleanor Ainsworth
bio:
Eleanor Ainsworth is a seasoned Head of Operations with a career spanning over two decades in motorsport. Her journey began unconventionally, not on the track, but in the engineering workshops of a local racing team, where she discovered her knack for streamlining processes and optimizing performance. A meticulous planner with a keen eye for detail, Eleanor's rise through the ranks was fueled by her ability to identify bottlenecks and implement innovative solutions. 

At Team Penske, Eleanor is responsible for overseeing all operational aspects of the team, from logistics and resource allocation to race strategy and pit stop coordination. Her approach is characterized by a data-driven methodology and a relentless pursuit of efficiency. She fosters a culture of continuous improvement within her team, encouraging collaboration and open communication. What sets Eleanor apart is her ability to anticipate potential challenges and develop proactive strategies to mitigate risks, ensuring that Team Penske remains at the forefront of motorsport innovation.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave.
physical.description: Eleanor is of medium height with a poised and professional demeanor.
